title: Due-Date Change Allowances — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tiers
content:
**Account changes schedule: due dates — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

A Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract may have its due date changed within the allowances below, which follow the tier the contract is booked on.

| Tier | Due-date changes over the life of the contract | Installments satisfied before a change | Most calendar days the first installment on the new due day may fall after the current next due date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5 | 1 | 6 | 10 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 4 | 1 | 6 | 15 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 3 | 1 | 6 | 15 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 2 | 2 | 3 | 20 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1 | 2 | 3 | 20 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+ | 3 | 3 | 25 |

| Allowance common to every tier | Figure |
|---|---|
| Earliest day of the month allowed as a due day | 1 |
| Latest day of the month allowed as a due day | 28 |
| Minimum calendar months between two due-date changes | 12 |

### Notes

- Due days run from the 1st to the 28th of the month on every tier; the 29th, 30th and 31st are never due days.
- The lifetime allowance counts every due-date change made on the contract; Tier 1+ allows three, Tier 2 and Tier 1 allow two, and Tier 5, Tier 4 and Tier 3 allow one.
- The installments-satisfied figure is a count of installments already satisfied on the contract at the time of the change.
